purpose: Qualify M1 and M2 on identical frozen historical tapes before any M3 runtime or closed-loop implementation.

arms.A0: authoritative native PMFS posterior and native planner
arms.F00: M1 mean projection plus frozen count likelihood; native planner
arms.F01: M1 complete empirical count law plus M2 categorical proper log score; native planner
arms.F11: F01 inference plus M3 information action; closed-loop only

m2_predictive_law.outcome: cumulative observed hit count H on the visible route prefix
m2_predictive_law.update_ownership: recompute the current-prefix posterior from q0; do not multiply dependent source-update snapshots or native PMFS source evidence

m3_action_law.selection: maximize information over the unchanged feasible action set; break exact ties by minimum native travel cost then stable action index

gate.m1: F00 vs A0 must have a clear cross-House increment on at least one eligible metric, no significant final-error worsening, and no stable reverse House.
gate.m2: F01 vs F00 must have a clear cross-House increment on at least one eligible metric, true-source rank in the same direction, no significant final-error worsening, and no stable reverse House.
gate.m2_destructive_control: F01 must beat the per-tape median over every canonical non-identity source-law reassignment on final error or error AUC, with true-source rank in the same direction.
gate.statistics: one-sided exact paired sign test p<=0.05; stable reverse means worse House mean with at least 8 of 10 losses.
gate.authorization: Only M1+M2 PASS authorizes runtime parity and a preregistered M3 closed-loop smoke. It never establishes M3 or a three-module PASS by itself.

prohibited: outcome-selected alpha, temperature, blend, threshold, House or seed
reuse of old persistent-sensor or stop-resolved NO-GO modules
claiming PSRG or CDIG telemetry as a main-module robot-task increment
starting closed loop before M1 and M2 offline PASS
